Jet Ski Rentals Tampa Bay

Check Availability & Book
📞 Call Now

Ride the Best Jet Ski Rentals in Tampa Bay

Looking for jet ski rentals in Tampa Bay? Xtreme Jetski Watersports is located in St Petersburg, FL and proudly serves riders from across the Tampa Bay area — including Tampa, Clearwater, St Pete Beach, and surrounding Gulf communities.

Just a short drive over the bridge, you’ll launch directly into open Gulf waters with access to Egmont Key, Shell Key, and some of the clearest water in the region.

If you’re searching for jet ski rentals near Tampa, this is where locals and visitors choose to ride.

Why Tampa Bay Riders Choose Xtreme

✔ Brand New Yamaha WaveRunners with Bluetooth Audio
✔ Launch Directly into Open Gulf Waters
✔ Crystal Clear Water & Island Destinations
✔ 5.0 Rated by 365+ Riders on Google
✔ No Hidden Fees
✔ Instant Online Booking

Unlike congested downtown launch points, our location gives Tampa Bay riders faster access to open water, dolphins, and scenic island riding without marina traffic delays.

Just Minutes from Tampa – Worth the Ride

Many of our customers drive from Tampa because:

• You get true Gulf access, not just bay cruising
• You avoid no-wake zones and river traffic
• You can ride to Egmont Key
• You get premium, fully loaded skis — not base models

We are easily accessible from Tampa via the Howard Frankland Bridge and Gandy Bridge.

The short drive gives you a dramatically better riding experience.

Explore the Best Riding Areas in Tampa Bay

When you rent with us, you can explore:

Egmont Key

Crystal clear water, historic lighthouse views, and dolphin sightings.

Shell Key

A hidden island paradise perfect for sandbar stops and photos.

Open Gulf Waters

Wide open throttle, smooth riding, and unbeatable scenery.

This is why riders searching for jet ski rentals Tampa Bay end up choosing our St Petersburg launch.

Who We Serve

We regularly welcome riders from:

• Tampa
• South Tampa
• Clearwater
• Brandon
• Riverview
• Wesley Chapel
• Largo
• St Pete Beach

If you're anywhere in the Tampa Bay region, we are your premium jet ski rental destination.

Jet Ski Rental Requirements in Tampa Bay

Before booking, keep in mind:

• Operators must be 16+
• Renters must be 18+
• Anyone born after Jan 1, 1988 must complete a Florida boating safety test
• Valid photo ID required

You can complete the temporary boating certificate online before your ride.

Ready to Ride Tampa Bay?

If you're searching for jet ski rentals Tampa Bay, book your ride today and experience the difference.

Our brand new Yamaha WaveRunners, open Gulf access, and 5-star safety record make us the top choice for riders across the region.
